_source: Sampled 2026-11-09 by alpha-code#1668 (L6), same engine and mock as read-tool.json: one turn whose mock tool call is `write b.txt` in the git project. Records are /api/event frames with the message page read right after each frame; records at session.step.ended / session.execution.* also carry `diff` = GET /api/session/:id/diff?from=<the turn's user message> taken at that moment (2.x's per-turn diff, REQ-142). `diff` at the top level is the same call after the run went idle.

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..64cdf3a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/b.txt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
